input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, I found:

H1 (Restatements/Corrections): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. Evidence E10 and E11 indicate only routine reclassifications to conform prior period presentation, which are described as "normal and recurring in nature" adjustments. There is no evidence of material restatements or corrections to Services revenue figures that would alter the reported 16% growth rate.

H2 (One-time items/Non-recurring revenue): NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE. The retrieved evidence discusses general litigation settlements and privacy compliance but does not provide specific information about one-time items or non-recurring revenue affecting Services in Q2 2026. The absence of such disclosure does not support the challenge.

H3 (Category definition changes): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. Evidence E18 shows the Services category consistently includes "amortization of the deferred value of services bundled in the sales price of certain products" across multiple periods, indicating consistent definition. Evidence E10 mentions only presentation reclassifications, not substantive category changes.

The original verdict remains SUPPORTED. The evidence clearly shows Services net sales of $30,976 million for Q2 2026 versus $26,645 million for Q2 2025, representing 16% growth, which exceeds the claimed threshold of 10%. No challenges were substantiated by the evidence.
